liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes Phil bombs in He's Gone; Reviewer likes the echoey He's Gone coda leading into Miracle [42][45]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review, 1 other source): Playin' starts like a reprise, but the band then sings all the lyrics; Playin' In The Band is the only inverted song in this show [4][41]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): Reviewer praises the nice slide work in C.C. Rider [42]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 other source): Notes say Playing in the Band is the only inverted song [1]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer finds Don't Ease Me In not that great, unlike most of the show [42]
- **I Need a Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the jam after China Doll, plus Miracle and Day Tripper, as rocking [43]
- **Jam** (1 other source): The jam out of China Doll is only Jerry and the rhythm devils [6]
- **Day Tripper** (1 review): Audience recording captures the crowd reacting to the opening notes of Day Tripper [41]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-31.142788.mtx.Miller.Oade.mdmilhausen.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 136 min [1]
